scope: Self-built portfolio system; findings are development/control-design exceptions, not client audit findings.
method: New negative/adversarial tests were intentionally added before remediation so CI could demonstrate which control assumptions failed.

findings.finding: A reused idempotency key could silently return the original request even when the caller changed the action or payload.
findings.remediation: Reject conflicting reuse, record idempotency_key_conflict, and preserve identical-request replay behavior.

findings.finding: A privileged requester could execute their own action after another administrator approved it.
findings.remediation: Prohibit requester execution and audit requester_execution_prohibited.

findings.finding: Non-finite numeric payload values (NaN and infinities) were accepted by scalar validation.
findings.remediation: Require finite numeric values before persistence.

findings.finding: Whitespace-only idempotency keys were treated as if no idempotency control had been requested.
findings.remediation: Normalize and reject blank idempotency keys.

findings.finding: Audit analytics did not flag approval events with no prior request in the analyzed sequence.
Audit analytics did not flag multiple approvals for the same action.
Audit analytics did not flag multiple execution events for the same action.
findings.remediation: Track executed resources and add DUPLICATE_EXECUTION exception logic.

findings.finding: Audit analytics did not identify requester self-execution in the event sequence.
Execution for an unknown action resource was only flagged as missing approval, not missing request provenance.
Deleting the most recent audit event left the remaining hash chain internally valid, so tail truncation was not detected.
findings.remediation: Persist an independent local chain checkpoint with expected event count and last event hash; verification now checks both the chain and checkpoint.

findings.finding: Execution trusted an approved status even when approval provenance fields were missing or represented self-approval after direct data tampering.
findings.remediation: Require approved_at and independent approved_by metadata before execution; invalid provenance is denied and audited.

findings.finding: The audit store accepted blank actor, action, or outcome fields, weakening evidentiary quality.
findings.remediation: Normalize and reject blank required audit-event fields in local and BigQuery audit paths.

historical_ci.run_65: 12 failed adversarial test cases, 18 existing tests passed.
historical_ci.run_69: 6 failed second-round adversarial test cases, 30 tests passed.

claims_boundary: The findings show iterative control testing and remediation on a self-built fictional system. They are not independent audit findings, production exceptions, or evidence of operating effectiveness over a client population.
